name: LDO Orbiter v2.5
description: The LDO Orbiter v2.5 is an upgraded direct drive extruder sharing the same firmware configuration as the v2.0 (690 steps/mm, rotation distance 4.69). Key improvements include dual drive gears with RNC nano coating (HRC60+), an improved spider shaft with 20–30 µm concentricity (down from 50–140 µm in v2.0), and upgraded MF679ZZ internal bearings. Compatible with Orbiter v2.0 mounts.
